For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor; a dedicated graphics card isn't needed unless you'll train AI projects.

Processor: Ryzen 5 or 7, Core i5 or i7 from the last two generations, or an Apple M-series chip.
Memory: 16 GB at minimum. Pick one where it can be upgraded to 32 GB.
Screen and keyboard: a 14 or 15-inch full HD IPS screen and a comfortable keyboard matter more than raw speed, since you'll stare at code all day.
Battery: look for real-world reviews of 8 hours or more.

What will you mostly build: web or app work, or data and AI projects? That decides whether I'd steer you to a lightweight laptop or one with a graphics card.
